ffn_scope: all configured FFNs, both multi-token prefill and every scored single-token decode; fixed historical W8; shared-64 A8 stratified input and post-SwiGLU streams; continuous FP32 SiLU(g)*u; BF16 interface
parameter_guard: parameter and six immutable FFN weight-buffer identity/data_ptr/version; mutable diagnostics excluded

sampling_stats.rng_scope: independent per-layer selector/sampler streams; seed excludes S/backend; paired only for fixed batch and step ordering
sampling_stats.scope: all configured single-token decode attention layers; original QKV/RoPE/cache/Wo; multi-token prefill attention is original SDPA; FFN follows joint case configuration
sampling_stats.limitation: ideal FP32 Philox Bernoulli; not hardware RNG, q/256 sampler or cycle-accurate PPA

rng_scope: FFN input/product 700001/700002+1000*seed+7*layer; selector 2100+10000*seed+layer; attention sampler 5100+10000*seed+layer; independent generators, pairing requires fixed batch/ordering and identical inputs
precision: original model/cache/output dtype; FP32 FFN arithmetic, logits/cross_entropy; FP64 NLL accumulation
limitations: suffix protocol scores selected suffixes and must not be called full WT2 PPL
full cached every-target protocol differs from vectorized BF16 sliding-window environment anchor
multi-token prefill attention is accurate SDPA; stochastic FFNs still run during prefill
fixed batch shapes and segment order required for paired random-stream comparisons
ideal Philox/FP32 sampler and GPU reference elapsed time are not hardware RNG validation or ASIC cycles
stratified FFN draws enforce interval coverage and are not unconstrained IID
